path.aria-label: How We Score Fire Risk: Liquid Fuel

g.aria-label: PSI-69 (FLEX): liquid fuel drops: Heptane & Methanol
Burn Time Split all tests into 3 equal groups (tertiles)
Droplet Diameter Reduction % (droplet initial diameter – extinction diameter)x100 ÷
droplet initial diameter Split all tests into 3 equal groups (tertiles)
Combustion Score = (burn time tertile + Droplet Diameter Reduction % tertile) ÷ 2
Example (FLEX Test #34, Methanol): burn time 27.3 s → High (2) + droplet shrank 48.6% → Mid (1) Score = (2 + 1) ÷ 2 = 1.5 → MEDIUM RISK
